well short of the 1e-12 target, so the structure is still wrong.

The best candidate I scored is `c0 + c1*v**2 + c2*t*log(1+c3*x) + c4*sqrt(t)*v + c5*sin(v)`, with fitted c3 ≈ 0.89. The two unidentified terms are guesses picked from a library of product forms, and no pair of them gave an exact fit.
